description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaKeysModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC layer. It includes class declarations for the service interface and its factory, along with methods for client connection management.

classes.name: IMediaKeysModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaKeysModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the Media Keys Module Service, handling client connection and disconnection.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaKeysModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysModuleService, given a reference to an ICdmService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client connects to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client disconnects from the IPC service.
